verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The body copy is set larger than the CTA, the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow has shrunk to an unreadable hairline under the headline, the legal text is microscopic, and the CTA button is a tiny pill wedged in the lower right. That buries the action and flips the hierarchy. A's button and label are slightly bigger and more readable; B's 'Reserve a Case' is squeezed into an even smaller, more cramped pill.
